 TRAINING. 24/10/2026 Eduardo Olivera Photographer: Antonio Villalba Our team completed their final training session at the Ciudad Real Madrid ahead of El Clásico. José Mourinho 's players will visit Camp Nou to face Barcelona in the tenth matchday of LaLiga (Sunday, 9:00 pm CEST; Orange TV and Dazn).
 The squad started the session with warm-ups and rondos on the pitch. Next, the players performed various possession and pressing exercises. The training concluded with shots on goal. Asencio trained individually on the pitch, while Rodrygo continues his recovery process.
